title: Gold, Silver! Can the Midterm Rally Keep Running? | Metals Minute
summary: Gold prices surged past $4,100 and silver neared $53 as precious metals extended their rally following the midterm election results (0:16). In this update, Chief Market Strategist Phil Streible breaks down how a divided government is impacting the markets, triggering a 378-point jump in the Dow while splitting the AI data center trade (0:10).
